notes:
New in this beta:

- First-run setup: a short walkthrough the first time you open Hotaru - your Gemini key, pick a soul, choose a personality and name, and connect Telegram. Skip anything. Run it again any time from Settings -> Get started.
- Meeting and lecture notes: say "take notes for this lecture" or tap Meeting / Lecture in the Control Centre's Today tab. Hotaru only listens - no wake word, no replies - until you press Stop on the island. Then it writes your notes (summary, key points, to-dos, and for lectures the key concepts and what to review), saves them to Documents\Hotaru Notes and opens them. To-dos go straight onto your list.
- When Google is busy or your free Gemini limit runs out, Hotaru now falls back to a lighter model instead of giving up.
